_comment: Captured from a real `conftest test --policy policy/rego --output json` run, then extended with
two cases the live repository does not currently produce.
infra/legacy/import.tf appears in expected_files but not in report: a file that exists in a gated
root and was never evaluated. That is the case the population reconciliation exists to catch, and
the reason the collector enumerates files from the working tree instead of trusting the report.
infra/network/peering.tf carries advisory findings only, so the bundle lands on warn rather than
fail — a distinction that disappears if a gate is reduced to a single exit code.

warnings.msg: KSI-CNA-RNT: aws_security_group.app_direct opens 8080-8080 to the internet, which is outside the declared public service ports [80, 443]. Confirm this belongs in the public surface.
KSI-IAM-ELP: the policy document on aws_iam_role_policy.peering is built by an unresolved expression and was not evaluated. Run this gate against `terraform show -json` plan output to decide it.
KSI-MLA-LET: aws_cloudtrail.partial is not multi-region, so activity in unlisted regions is unlogged.

failures.msg: KSI-CNA-RNT / KSI-CNA-MAT: aws_security_group.everything allows all protocols from the internet. Restrict the protocol and port range, or scope the source to a CIDR inside the boundary.
KSI-CNA-RNT / KSI-CNA-MAT: aws_security_group.bastion exposes administrative port(s) [22] to the internet via the range 22-22. Front them with SSM Session Manager or a private endpoint.
KSI-MLA-ALA: aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.uploads sets block_public_policy = false. All four must be true; a partial block is not a block.
KSI-MLA-OSM: aws_cloudtrail.partial disables log file validation, which is what makes the audit record tamper-evident.
